notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Strikers,[/h2][p][/p][p]We wanted to give you a quick update on what’s going on behind the scenes. Development is still moving forward, but we’ve been facing some financial challenges lately, which is why content updates have taken a bit longer than expected.[/p][p]That said, we’re not stopping! 💪 To keep you excited, here’s a little [b]sneak peek[/b]: we’re working on [b]UI updates and visual improvements[/b] that will make Entity Strike even more satisfying to navigate and play both in the HUD and across the entire interface. We can’t wait to show you more soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/4528989ee5b5c9e74c3a40d5a800f988a3034cc4.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support — it really means a lot to us. Every bit of feedback, every message, every wishlist helps us keep pushing Entity Strike forward.
[/p][h3][i]Stay tuned, the best is yet to come! 🚀 - Entity Strike Dev Team[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Entity Strike – Patch Notes v0.43
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Survivors,[/b][/h1][p]Here’s what’s new (and fixed!) in this update:[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Features & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Unlocks & Achievements[/b]
Unlocked and locked items are now much easier to spot at a glance. Progress feels more rewarding![/p][/*][*][p][b]Full Screen / Windowed Mode[/b]
You can now freely switch between fullscreen and windowed modes just how you like it![/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck[/b]
Improved compatibility and testing for a better handheld experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolution Improvements[/b]
HUD bars and UI elements are now better positioned on 2560 x 1440 displays.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Damage Feedback[/b]
Taking damage now gives immediate visual feedback, no more confusion when you get hit![/p][/*][*][p][b]Death Animations[/b]
Added preview death animations for the player [b]and[/b] enemies. (This update introduces a preview animation for one enemy type soon, each enemy will have its own unique death style!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dash Spawn Safety[/b]
Dashing into freshly spawned enemies no longer ruins your run. Increased the minimum spawn distance from the player (now 22 units away, outside the viewport).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot Drops Reworked[/b]
First Aid and Shield Armor drops are now balanced:[/p][list][*][p]Guaranteed no more than 2 of each per wave.[/p][/*][*][p]No more waves with zero drops, but no overflooding either![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Random Game Freezes[/b]
Improved overall game stability and reduced freezes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio Startup Bug[/b]
Fixed an issue where sometimes the game would start with no sound. If it happens, restarting will bring the audio back.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Custom death animations for all enemy types are coming soon! This update brings a sneak peek with one enemy type now featuring its own unique death animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Some advanced visual effects, animations and UI polish are still WIP.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming each suggestion moves the game forward![/b]
[i]Team Entity Strike[/i][/p]

notes.title: Massive Visual Update + New Wave XP System!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h2][p]We’ve been hard at work improving [b]Entity Strike[/b], and this update is one of our biggest yet in terms of visuals, gameplay clarity, and user experience.
[/p][p][b]🆕 What’s New:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Wave-based XP System:[/b] Now you gain XP killing enemies this makes progression cleaner and more rewarding between combat waves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New HUD Layout:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]XP Level[/b] is now displayed at the [b]top left[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wave Counter[/b] sits at the [b]top center[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Credits (Beta)[/b] at the [b]top right[/b] (not functional yet, but planned for future systems).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wave Kill Count[/b] is also shown for better combat feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Selected Weapon Display[/b] is now visible with [b]placeholder icons[/b] for now — this helps you keep track of your current weapon in the heat of battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Stats Bars[/b] (HP, Armor, Dash, Ammo, etc.) are now repositioned at the [b]bottom[/b], cleaner and easier to track during fights.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Complete Visual Overhaul:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New player animations[/p][/*][*][p]Better lighting, VFX, explosions, and UI polish[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Pistol Upgrades Added![/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Explosive Ammo[/b] — Your shots now cause explosions on impact for AoE damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Rate Upgrade[/b] — Shoots faster, increasing DPS and letting the pistol feel much deadlier.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tons of behind-the-scenes improvements and prep for future features.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/af280a9e2bb1affaf8079f2214f72e6e23450f48.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re getting closer to the vision we have for [b]Entity Strike[/b], and this is only possible thanks to the community following and supporting this project. Your feedback is always welcome — drop your thoughts, ideas, or bug reports![/p][p]Stay tuned. More to come very soon. 🔥

⚠️ [i]All content shown is subject to change and does not represent the final quality of the product.[/i][/p][p]— The Tropical Pixel Studios Team 🌴[/p]

notes.title: DEV LOG #07 - New languages support and reroll
notes.content:
[h1][b]🚀 Update: Reroll System + Multilingual Support![/b][/h1]
Hey survivors!
We're excited to bring you another quality-of-life update packed with improvements that make Entity Strike even more accessible and strategic.

[h2][b]🔁 New: Reroll System[/b][/h2]
Feeling unlucky with your upgrade options?
You can now reroll your available upgrades during the run!
Spend a few points and refresh your choices to chase that perfect synergy. Choose smarter, survive longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/95ab55ef1d2e6872c4dea35e16a15f5700d13b12.png[/img]

[h2]🌍 New: Multilingual Support[/h2]
Entity Strike is now available in 11 languages, making it easier than ever for players around the world to join the chaos!

[b]Supported Languages:
[/b]
[list]
[*] 🇺🇸 English
[*] 🇧🇷 Portuguese
[*] 🇫🇷 French
[*] 🇩🇪 German
[*] 🇪🇸 Spanish
[*] 🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese
[*] 🇰🇷 Korean
[*] 🇯🇵 Japanese
[*] 🇵🇱 Polish
[*] 🇷🇺 Russian
[*] 🇹🇷 Turkish
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/ff2a3aa4c43fb226cae7a8244ab1e30c927100a7.png[/img]

You can change the language from the Options Menu at any time.

Thanks for all your feedback and support — keep those entities coming! 💥
More updates soon with new content, balance changes and juicy upgrades.
Stay tuned, and happy surviving!

— Tropical Pixel Studios

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/05ac9249e41557e113d58e529240d956c510e308.png[/img]

[h2]👾 New Enemy: The Ghoul Spitter[/h2]
A terrifying new ranged threat joins the fray! The [b]Ghoul Spitter[/b] launches acid projectiles that leave dangerous puddles on the battlefield, forcing you to stay mobile and adapt your tactics.

notes.title: DEV LOG #05 – Explosive Dash, Temporary UI & Loot Overhaul
notes.content:
[b]👋 Hey everyone![/b]
It’s time for another dev log, and this one comes packed with important changes and improvements based on your feedback:

[b]🔦 Flashlight Upgrade Rework[/b]
The flashlight's brightness and range upgrades have been adjusted for a better tactical experience, making exploration more immersive and visually striking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/c61e94ecc032a3aeebeec2cf969bcd3f1a66f116.png[/img]

[b]🎨 Temporary UI Overhaul[/b]
We’re currently testing a new placeholder UI, created by a commissioned artist. This isn’t the final version, but a visual step forward while we plan to hire a full art team (or at least someone who feels like a whole team 😄).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/5e7a367c73b75f2d1eb53da75e6ca6a19df70af9.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Why this new UI matters:
[*] More visually appealing and modern
[*] Cleaner layout and better UX
[*] Sets the tone for the game’s future aesthetic
[/list]

🛡️ Armor System Update
Armor is no longer purchased as an upgrade — it now drops during runs, creating more dynamic and rewarding gameplay.

💥 New Dash System + Explosive Dash
We’ve added a brand-new dash mechanic!
For returning players who already purchased upgrades in the Score Store, we recommend using the Refund Score feature to reassign your points so the dash works properly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/929529c4a2e3cf300654059cae0b724158322792.png[/img]
There’s also a Meta Upgrade Rank 2 now available, unlocking an Explosive Dash variant!
[previewyoutube=N8KRnx_XNgA;full][/previewyoutube]

🛠️ Bug Fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the pistol stopped working at max upgrade
[*] Fixed duplicated boss audio instances
[*] Fixed a bug where pickable item crates were being detected as audio zones
[*] Adjusted the visual aura of pickable items for better in-game readability
[/list]

notes.title: DEV LOG #04 - 📊 Statistics System Now Available!
notes.content:

You can now view detailed stats directly from the level selection screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/8e30f7183b31a3eede38f0e36d3dfb76c00e70d9.png[/img]

📈 Track your progress with these new indicators:

[list]
[*] Enemies Killed

notes.title: DEV LOG #03 - Score Store Update – Permanent Upgrades & Achievements!
notes.content:
[h1]🛒 Score Store Update – Meta Progression Arrives![/h1]

Hey survivors!
Today’s update brings one of the most requested features: a full [b]meta progression system[/b] that allows you to permanently enhance your character between runs using your score.

[h2]🆕 Score Store Highlights[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/3bdd61e92dad955ced082d436638db63acd5cf1f.png[/img]

[b]8 new permanent upgrades[/b] available!

Each upgrade can be ranked up to [b]level 3[/b]

Over [b]8 new achievements[/b] added (1 per upgrade + full mastery trophies)

[h3]🔧 Upgrades and Their Effects:[/h3]

🧡 Survivor’s Instinct: Start with +10 permanent health

🎯 Ammo Mastery: Ammo drops 15% more frequently

🏃 Quick Feet: +25% permanent speed

💡 Flashlight Upgrade: +10% flashlight radius

💉 Field Medic: Regenerate 1 HP per second

🔄 Gun Master: Reload 10% faster

🤖 Drone Commander: Start each run with 1 mini drone

🔫 Extra Mags: Start each run with +2 magazines

[h2]🏆 New Achievements[/h2]
Each permanent upgrade now unlocks a unique Steam achievement at max rank — plus meta mastery trophies for 100% progression.

[h3]Examples:[/h3]

[b]Locked & Loaded[/b] – Max out Extra Mags

[b]Wingman[/b] – Max out Drone Commander

[b]Entity Ascended[/b] – Max out every upgrade in the store

[h2]✨ Other Improvements[/h2]

Better UI and tooltips in Score Store

Refund system added to reset progress if desired

More polish and clarity in descriptions and icons

[i]Keep sending your feedback — the game is evolving thanks to you![/i]
— Samuel (dev)

notes.title: DEV-LOG #02 - First Major Update – Melee, Auto Aim & QoL Fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]⚔️ First Major Update is Live![/h1]

Thank you all for playing [b]Entity Strike[/b]! Based on your feedback, we’re rolling out the first of many quality-of-life and gameplay improvements.

[b]🗡️ Basic Melee Attack[/b]
Now when you're out of ammo, press [b]F[/b] to perform a quick melee attack in an area around your character. It’s simple but can save your run!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/033cb9845b39d88c998d900fd5e78bab4ae583e7.png[/img]

[b]🎯 Auto Aim + Steam Controller Template Support[/b]
Auto aim is now active, letting you easily play with a gamepad using Steam Input. Your character will automatically target nearby enemies — including melee attacks when in range!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/8ac1cf4556b48a73b5fdb5f8c3d8388283530e70.jpg[/img]

[b]💉 Improved Drop Rates[/b]
Ammo and health drop more frequently, especially in earlier waves, and the difficulty ramp has been balanced so you don’t get overwhelmed right away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/a9fb044dd639d86ec74318c57958b2759713af97.png[/img]
[b]🏃 Speed Rebalance[/b]
Player speed has been slightly increased compared to zombies to give you more breathing room.

[b]🎮 UI Improvements[/b]
We updated the pause screen with better command labels and a reminder to press [b]F[/b] when out of ammo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600911/9578e853c8dbb897b16e0750cda6ae6fff1454d2.png[/img]

[h2]Next? Meta Progression![/h2]
We’re already working on a meta-upgrade system that lets you progress beyond each run — stay tuned!

[i]Thanks for your support! Your feedback is helping shape the future of Entity Strike.[/i]
— Samuel (dev)

Try it out and let us know what you think!
